newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales off 0.8 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales off 0.8 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales fell 0.8 percent in the week ended April 5 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 4.7 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was up 1.4 percent from the prior month.

"Sales were generally on-plan for most retailers," the report said. "Given that Easter occurred during the latest reporting week, most retailers had six selling days this year versus seven last year, which accentuated the year-over-year weakness in the raw data," it said.
The report, which is normally embargoed for 0900 EDT/1300 GMT, was again released early by other news services.
